arg.name: source_yaml_path
arg.description: Absolute path to the navigation graph YAML (zones + waypoints)

arg.name: eta_params_path
arg.description: Speeds used to turn the remaining path into eta_update

arg.name: level
arg.description: Building level name for zone tracking

arg.name: fleet_states_topic
arg.description: FleetState topic for robot pose updates

arg.name: monitored_task_topic
arg.description: Raw task details topic to subscribe (from execution)

arg.name: zone_status_topic
arg.description: Optional zone-only side topic

arg.name: publish_robot_zone_status
arg.description: If true, also publish zone-only messages on zone_status_topic

arg.name: publish_idle_robot_zones
arg.description: If true, publish current_zone on zone_status_topic for idle robots (no task)

arg.name: publish_rate_hz
arg.description: Rate (Hz) for flushing changed zone updates (unchanged robots skipped)

arg.name: publish_nav_graphs1
arg.description: If true, publish filtered Graph on nav_graphs1_topic from shared map cache

arg.name: nav_graphs1_topic
arg.description: Filtered nav graph topic (current + next-3 zones)

arg.name: graph_name
arg.description: Name field on published rmf_building_map_msgs/Graph

arg.name: publish_zone_markers
arg.description: If true, publish MarkerArray for zone waypoints/lanes/labels (no borders)

arg.name: zone_markers_topic
arg.description: RViz MarkerArray topic

arg.name: marker_frame_id
arg.description: TF frame for zone markers

arg.name: publish_zone_catalog
arg.description: Publish zone IDs from shared nav graph for zone_manager (no YAML reload)

arg.name: zone_catalog_topic
arg.description: Latched zone ID catalog topic for zone_manager

log.message: Starting zone_monitor_node (shared nav graph → zones + catalog + /nav_graphs1 + /zone_markers)

arg.name: enable_path_deviation_check
arg.description: If true, monitor AMRs for cross-track path deviation

arg.name: path_deviation_debounce_ticks
arg.description: Number of consecutive ticks required to confirm deviation or recovery

arg.name: path_deviation_topic
arg.description: Topic to publish path deviation and recovery alerts

arg.name: task_state_topic
arg.description: Topic for task state lifecycle updates

arg.name: path_deviation_rate_hz
arg.description: Evaluation rate (Hz) for path deviation checks

log.message: Starting path_deviation node (multi-segment cross-track error + debounce + recovery)
